Thanks for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to confirm how Redwood will bill since our contract covers two legal entities (Helix US and Helix Europe) and services will be consumed across multiple cost centers. They want:

- Separate invoice PDFs per legal entity, each with their own VAT handling
- Line-level mapping so we can auto-post to our chargeback system (cost center codes provided below)
- A single remittance address for payments but split accounting per entity

Cost center mappings: 
- CC1001 -> Helix US (entity: Helix US, tax id: 12-3456789)
- CC2002 -> Helix Europe (entity: Helix Europe B.V., VAT NL123456789B01)

Can Redwood produce a split invoice (same invoice date, different PDFs) and include the per-line entity tag so our AP can auto-route? Also confirm whether you will show VAT on the Helix Europe invoice or we should self-account via reverse charge.

We need this answered by COB Monday (23 Jun) to close our purchase order.

Thanks,
Amanda

Subject: RE: Split invoicing & VAT responsibilities for PO #4521

Hi team — reviewed. We can support the requested approach but need the following to be documented before we finalize templates: 

1) Entity assignment per line (Helix US vs Helix Europe) — customer must provide confirmed VAT ID for EU entity.
2) For Helix Europe: if services delivered to an EU business (B2B), our standard is to apply reverse charge (no VAT shown) but we can display VAT amount if customer requests and provides local tax instructions.
3) Invoicing mechanics: separate PDFs per entity; invoice numbers will be entity-prefixed (RDW-US-####, RDW-EU-####). Remit can be a single address block but we will include the entity legal name and tax id on each PDF.
4) Accounting detail: we will include line-level custom field "entity_code" that maps to your cost center. That appears in the PDF and the invoice XML/CSV export for your AP system.

Questions for Amanda: please confirm VAT ID for Helix Europe and whether you want VAT shown or handled via reverse charge. Also confirm whether Helix requires separate bank accounts on the remittance advice (we can include bank info per entity, but payments will reconcile to a single clearing account unless otherwise requested).

If we get the VAT ID and remit instructions by Monday morning, Billing Ops can build the templates and provide sample PDFs by Tuesday EOD.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
